preregistered_0_5_requirements.criterion: A real parser, type checker, and deterministic compiler execute the same Core programs with declared-contract equivalence; no flow, machine, UI, GPU, or package/runtime expansion before this passes.
Core internal bindings remain 100% Exact with zero Unknown on a preregistered held-out corpus; foreign imports remain explicit and separately counted.

Human-adjudicated source-product Rename, Move, and ChangeSignature cases are applied in isolated copies and preserve declared tests/contracts; report false-safe and false-block denominators per operation.
At least 600 independently adjudicated changed-identity predictions satisfy the hashing policy confidence gate; only explicit ChangeIR provenance may auto-inherit identity.
Same model, tasks, repository revisions, tools, and success oracle compare Python sidecar and Core; report task success, input/output tokens, tool calls, wall time, and failures.
Compare Task Capsules at equal task-success; byte or token reduction without equal success is not sufficient.
Complete behavioral validation across multiple source-product repositories and categories; planner-preflight labels alone do not count as ground truth.

reason: The closed CoreIR lab produced positive synthetic measurements, but independent identity labels, broad external behavioral validation, same-model agent A/B, and an executable compiler/runtime are absent.
stop_conditions: Any false-safe semantic change remains unexplained.
Core admits unresolved internal names or implicit ambient effects.
Agent success regresses materially at equal task definition.
Compiler/runtime work requires flow, machine, UI, GPU, package manager, or new runtime before the small frontend experiment passes.
